title: Brazil bill aims to ban satellite tool (DETER) used to slow Amazon deforestation
snippet: Brazilian agribusiness caucus accelerating bill to ban remote embargoes (satellite-based deforestation enforcement). IBAMA uses INPE's DETER system (near-real-time satellite imagery) to identify illegal deforestation and issue ~4,000 embargoes/year (~500,000ha). Ban could reverse system that halved Amazon deforestation under Lula administration.
